contact.basis: Ground beneath the center of Y. Each letter and its support feet sample the preserved terrain separately within this common datum.

verticalDatum: USGS 3DEP service elevation in meters; local visualization datum, not a surveyed site benchmark
method: Unmodified USGS 3DEP F32 elevation export bilinearly sampled through the GeoTIFF pixel-center georeference into a 3 m local grid. No terrain flattening or fitting. Export pixels oversample the underlying DEM; native resolution and vertical accuracy are unknown.
limitations: Export pixel spacing is not native resolution or accuracy. Site slopes and footings are generalized.
The first Terrarium source produced an implausible 10 m arch when used to set panel levels. USGS elevation and photographic panel alignment are recorded separately.
Runtime terrain-contact uses the Y reference point; other host terrain datasets may differ locally.
